name: Positioning map
line: Finds the differences buyers actually choose on, maps every competitor, and writes the positioning in one phrase.
use: A company or product needs to know where it stands and what space it can own.
gets: A primary positioning map, a factor profile and a scored evidence table, plus a positioning phrase and statement.

name: Messaging house
line: Turns a positioning into one page everyone can reuse: core message, three pillars with proof, and a foundation.
use: Sales, marketing and leadership need to say the same thing, with proof.
gets: A messaging house visual, persona variants, 10-second to 2-minute pitches and boilerplate, all copy-ready.
origin: Built from my product marketing work.

name: ICP and buyer personas
line: Defines the ideal customer, maps who buys and how, and shows where to find each buyer.
use: Sales and marketing need to know which companies to target, who decides, and how to reach them.
gets: An ICP scorecard, a buying committee map, a buying journey and persona cards with pains, triggers, objections and channels.
get: ICP, buying committee, journey and personas

name: Market intelligence newsletter
line: Give it a company name. Get a weekly, sourced briefing for that company's leadership.
use: A leadership team needs to know what competitors, regulators and the market did this week.
gets: A minimal letter in Byzantine purple and Montserrat: bold headline, source, and 1–3 sentences on why it matters, for each item.
origin: Built from my market intelligence work.

name: Social media content
line: Posts and paid ads for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and X, at the right size, ready to download.
use: A brand needs organic posts or ad creatives for one or more platforms.
gets: Every asset at its exact size in a preview artifact, plus a zip of PNGs and a copy sheet ready for Ads Manager.
origin: Built from my content and campaign work.

name: Brochure maker
line: Brochures that look made for one client by a good agency, not pulled from a template.
use: Someone needs a tri-fold, bi-fold, product booklet, leaflet or flyer.
gets: A panel map, three visual directions, a locked design system, then a print PDF with bleed, a screen PDF and a handoff note for the print shop.
origin: Built from my brochure projects with Claude.

name: Logo maker
line: From a company's website to three named logo directions, then a final SVG kit.
use: A client, a prospect or one of my own ventures needs a logo or brand mark.
gets: Three directions side by side, then the chosen mark as SVG and PNG in every lockup, a mini guideline and a brand block for website builders.
origin: Distilled from the Stromal Therapeutics and Myney logo work.

name: Business card maker
line: A card people keep: one clear name, one reason to remember, contacts readable at arm's length.
use: A business card for me, a client or a venture.
gets: Three front-and-back directions, a real tested QR code, the final card at 85 × 55 mm and print specs with paper and finish suggestions.
origin: Built around my own AI Marketing Services card.
